== Strategy ==

Enough has been said about these decks.  I love Star Destroyers.
And with all of the admirals at deathstar in a ship with the objective flipped they deploy -6.

The Objective need to be flipped as quickly as possible because until the deck will be very seceptible to force drains.

Danroe-before the objective is flipped, it is nice to be given the chance to avoid the massive drain at the Death Star.

Accuser-also positive against a drain at the Death Star.

Ozzel-only draw back is destiny 0 since no Vader in this deck.

The Locations are for force draining.  If I take out those locations, I should take out the Fear Will Keep Them In Line (V) and the Admiral Chiraneau because I believe they are contingent on battle ground systems and then I would only have 2 of them.  How would one get the opponent lured into space when you are not draining them into space?  If I was loosing 4 force per Battle Ground System then I would venture there to stop them, but for a force or 2, I would rather avoid them.  I would end up dead from a ground deck if not for the massive drains.
